sloka: शुश्रुवुश्चतदा शब्दमृषीणां भावितात्मनाम्।चारणानां च सिद्धानां स्थितानांविमलेऽम्बरे॥५-१-२८॥
transliteration: śuśruvuścatadā śabdamṛṣīṇāṁ bhāvitātmanām।cāraṇānāṁ ca siddhānāṁ sthitānāṁvimale'mbare॥5-1-28॥

translations.english: Then the vidyadharas heard the words of praise(of Hanuman) by the sages, seekers of the ultimate truth, the charanas and the siddhas who stood and watched in the clear sky:
